item.title: [SE Unit] ADVA / JA Dengue Slayers Challenge 2026
item.description: Dear Students, Students interested in innovation, public health, and media campaigns may wish to explore the ADVA / JA Dengue Slayers Challenge 2026, a regional competition focused on developing ideas and communication strategies to address the dengue endemic. This year’s theme is “Innovate. Influence. Eliminate Dengue.” Teams will work on solutions and short-form video campaigns that encourage community action and behavioural change. Who can participate Age: 16–19 Team size: 3 students Participants will also attend workshops on Design Thinking and Pitch & Presentation, and selected teams may have the opportunity to represent Singapore at the Asia Pacific Grand Finals. 📅 Registration deadline: 30 March For more details about the competition and how to prepare your pitch, please refer to the SE Website .

item.title: Our Hwa Chong Conversations (OHCC), 2nd April
item.description: Hey Hwa Chong! 👋👋 Curious about the issues shaping Singapore and ASEAN today? Want a space to share your views, hear different perspectives, and dive into real-world case studies with your peers? 👀💬 Our Hwa Chong Conversations (OHCC) is back! 💬🌏 Join us for an engaging and meaningful afternoon of discussion as we explore topics surrounding Singapore, ASEAN, and the world around us. Whether you’re someone who enjoys current affairs, likes hearing fresh perspectives, or simply wants to learn more in a fun and interactive setting, OHCC is for you ✨ Expect thought-provoking conversations, interesting case studies, and a chance to better understand the issues that shape our society and region today, all while having a good time with friends 😆 So if you’re looking to spend your afternoon doing something fun, meaningful, and a little different, come join us! 🗓️ 2 April (Thursday) ⏰ 1600–1800 📍 E201–E205 Sign-up here: https://forms.gle/LSEd8mp8TWFYt5kZ9 😆🗣️ We hope to see you there!

item.title: [SL] Project Daylight: 1 April Volunteering Session
item.description: HEY Hwa Chong! ♥️💛 Are you looking for a way to make a difference in the lives of the elderly🧓? Look no further, we are Project Daylight ☀️, which aims to bring some light to the elderly by creating a warm and cheerful ☺️ atmosphere for the elderly to enjoy themselves. We are partnering with St. Luke’s Eldercare Senior Centre. Activities include card games🃏, handicrafts🎨 and mini games🎲! Not only will you be able to forge meaningful connections♥️ with the elderly, you will also be awarded 1.5 CIP hours!😁 Date: 1 April 2026 (FLD Wednesday) Time: 10am – 11.30am Venue: St Luke’s Eldercare Senior Centre @ Kebun Bahru, 216 Ang Mo Kio Avenue 4 #04-01 Please fill in this google form (https://forms.gle/JNgsEqrTanBHZe6SA) if you’re interested! Do note that the form closes on 30 March 1800! Additionally, for students interested in volunteering regularly🥰 with us during FLD Wednesdays🗓️, please fill in this google form (https://forms.gle/GY4WXSAgNdE9gPyu7)! What are you waiting for ⁉️ Sign up today to make a difference in someone’s life! Love, Project Daylight OT ‘25-26 (For any questions, please gchat Alyssa at 211965j@student.hci.edu.sg!)

item.title: [SL] Project Starborn SL project takeover
item.description: Hey Hwachong! 👋 Are you interested in making a difference in the lives of children with special needs? We are Project Starborn, a Service Learning project with the aim of creating meaningful and engaging experiences for children with developmental needs. Through fun activities and occasional outings, we hope to provide them with opportunities to interact, build social and communication skills, and simply have an enjoyable and supportive time together. ⭐ We’re currently looking for passionate and committed people to drive our project as the next Organising Team (OT) of 26/27, to plan and run these activities. If you’re interested in engaging with the kids and contributing to a meaningful initiative, we’d love to have you on board! We’re Shanna, Gwen, Rishika, and Liying, and we’re excited to grow this project with others who share the same heart for service. If you’re interested, do sign up here: https://forms.gle/4Ga47kzTZM46fw5eA If you have any questions, feel free to just gchat any of us as well! We hope to see you join Project Starborn! ✨
